test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 10 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is India’s rank in the 2021 Global Hunger Index?
solution:
The correct answer is __**101**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Global Hunger Index **is a **tool that measures **and **tracks hunger globally **as well as by **region and by country**, prepared by **European NGOs **of **Concern Worldwide and Welthungerhilfe**.
 
• The **GHI **is **calculated annually**, and its **results appear **in **a report **issued in **October each year**.
 
• **A country's GHI score **is **calculated **by **averaging the percentage **of the **population **that is **undernourished**, the **percentage of children younger than five years **of age who are **underweight**, and **the percentage of children **who **die before the age of five**.
 
• In **the 2021 Global Hunger Index**, **India ranks 101st out of the 116 countries **with sufficient **data to calculate 2021 GHI scores**. With a score of **27.5**, India has a level of **hunger that is serious.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **In the 2021 Global Hunger Index**, **Pakistan ranks 92nd **out of the **116 countries **with sufficient data to calculate 2021 GHI scores.
 
• **Belarus **is at the **top of the GHI**.
 
• **Somalia **is at the **bottom of the GHI**.
